quotes.text: MedImageEdu is built from public or de-identified radiology sources, including MedThinkVQA cases derived from peer-reviewed Eurorad teaching files

parsed.rationale: The source of records is stated as public or de-identified real radiology data. No IRB determination, DUA or credentialing requirement, or de-identification method is described, and no data redistribution terms separate from the code licence are given.
